newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Force Corp can't explain share rise.
newsitem.headline: Force Corp can't explain share rise.

text.p: Property developer Force Corporation Ltd said in response to an enquiry by the New Zealand Stock Exchange that it could offer no reason why its share price had risen to 85 NZ cents on Friday morning from 77 cents on 4 February.
"The company is not in possession of information which, if generally available to the public, may be regarded as an explanation for the price variation," Force Corp said in a statement.
"The company has no reason to believe or suspect that any person has bought or sold Force Corporation shares based on any perceived information held by the company.

"There are no matters of importance concerning the company that are about to be announced to the Exchange, or could be announced to the Exchange, at this time, excepting the half yearly result which will be announced shortly as is normal.
"No officer or representative of the company has made any statement which would account for the share price fluctuation," Force Corp said.
